2: For the music director, upon stringed instruments. Of David. Hear, O God, my cry; attend to my prayer.
3: From the end of the earth I call to you when my heart grows faint. You will lead me to a rock that is higher than I.
4: For you have been my refuge, a strong tower from the enemy.
5: Let me reside in your tent forever. Let me take refuge under the covering of your wings. Selah
6: For you, O God, you have heard my vows. You have given me the heritage of those who fear your name.
7: You will add days to the days of the king, his years like those of ⌞many generations⌟.
8: May he live forever in the presence of God. Appoint loyal love and faithfulness to preserve him.
9: So I will sing the praise of your name forever, that I may fulfill my vows ⌞daily⌟.
